matches.name: divergence_add
matches.signature:
lemma divergence_add {f g : E → E} {x : E}
    (hf : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 f x) (hg : DifferentiableAt 𝕜 g x) :
    divergence 𝕜 (fun x => f x + g x) x
    =
    divergence 𝕜 f x + divergence 𝕜 g x

matches.name: second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually_of_real
matches.docstring:
If a function is differentiable around `x`, and has two derivatives at `x`, then the second
derivative is symmetric. Version over `ℝ`. See `second_derivative_symmetric_of_eventually` for a
version over `ℝ` or `ℂ`.
